Fixtures had to add a verification signal to keep passing: test_gate_engine_cutover.py '- [ ] seam calls X (`pytest -q`)', test_llm_failure_matrix.py '- [ ] unit tests cover it (`pytest -q`)', test_gate_error_sidecar.py '- [ ] x passes `pytest -q`', and _GOOD_AC gained a '## Testing' section in three workflow tests — evidence that plans previously passing now require the new signal
advisory.finding: P10 and P11 are added as BLOCKING DET checks on the default-blocking floor, hard-blocking previously-passing plans: any leaf plan without a `## Testing`/`## Verification` section AND without an AC item carrying a code span or the narrow verification vocabulary now blocks, and any plan whose AC lines contain a lexicon term now blocks. This is a backward-incompatible policy change for in-flight tickets.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Decide and document whether P11 should exempt containers like P10 does, or explicitly justify why P11 blocks containers on vague AC.
evidence: det_clarity.py:140-143 P10 short-circuits: `if ctx.has_children: return DetResult('P10', ..., 'pass', coverage={'ran': True, 'container': True})`
det_clarity.py:189-193 P11 runs `ac_item_lines(ctx.plan_text)` and flags with no `has_children` guard
P10 rationale at det_clarity.py:13-14 'A container is a natural pass (its children carry the verification detail).' — P11 lacks the parallel carve-out
advisory.finding: P11 (ac-vagueness) has no container exemption, unlike P10 which returns a natural pass for `ctx.has_children`. A container/parent plan whose high-level acceptance criteria use a lexicon term (e.g. 'reasonable', 'appropriate') will be hard-blocked even though the concrete, verifiable detail is expected to live in its children.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a P10 negative test: a leaf plan whose only 'testing'/'verify' occurrences are in prose (no `## Testing` H2, no qualifying AC item) must still return status=='fail' and blocking is True.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_clarity.py:51: `_TESTING_H2_RE = re.compile(r"^##\s+(?:Testing|Verification)\b", re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE)`

ABSENCE: search for 'Testing' in test_det_floor_clarity.py returns no matches other than the `## Testing` pass-case fixture; every P10 pass-case supplies a real H2 or a qualifying AC, and the sole fail-case (`test_p10_blocks_leaf_with_no_verification_signal`, line 52) uses '- [ ] the feature works for users' which contains no verification vocabulary at all — so precision of the H2 anchor / vocabulary regex is never exercised.
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_clarity.py:144: `has_section = bool(_TESTING_H2_RE.search(ctx.description))`
advisory.finding: P10 has no negative test proving it requires an H2 *section* (or an AC-item signal) rather than a mere prose mention: no leaf-plan case contains the words 'testing'/'verify'/'verification' only in prose (not as `## Testing` H2, not inside an AC checklist item) while still expecting a BLOCK. A regression that drops the `^##` anchor in `_TESTING_H2_RE` or loosens `_VERIFICATION_VOCAB_RE` so it matches ordinary AC prose would turn P10 into a near no-op undetected.

Migration-path mitigation (why this is borderline, for later-pass weighting): registry_version stamp rotation is grandfathered as non-blocking `registry_drift` per ADR-0053 (manifest.py:114-128 docstring), so STORED attestations stay valid; only LIVE gate runs on previously-passing plans newly block
advisory.finding: Two new DET checks P10 (verification-presence) and P11 (ac-vagueness) are added to DET_CHECKS as unconditional BLOCKING checks, changing the plan-review gate default: leaf plans that previously PASSED (an `## Acceptance Criteria` checklist with no `## Testing`/`## Verification` section and no verification-vocabulary/code-span AC, or any AC line containing a vague-lexicon term) now BLOCK a claim/transition on the `rebar review-plan` / `review_plan` gate. This is an unversioned changed-default / narrowed-accepted-input break on the gate contract.
scenarios: A downstream repo (or existing in-flight ticket) whose leaf plan has a valid AC checklist but no Testing/Verification section and no backticked/verification-vocabulary AC — previously PASSED, now BLOCKED on claim/transition
A leaf plan whose AC contains a term in the fixed vague lexicon (e.g. 'properly', 'reasonable', 'etc.' not adjacent to a code span) — previously PASSED, now BLOCKED
DET-only degraded mode (no [agents] extra / no API key): P10/P11 still block, so even offline claim paths change verdict for these plans
